reviews.review_description: The gameplay is fun, and it looks like it will get better. There are some flaws with it. The voices seem to be done by AI, and they do make some mistakes. There also seems to be some functions that lack sound effects. The graphics look pretty good for a Quest game, and the guns are pretty well done. I think Ill have some fun with it.

I love this game so much, and I’m about 1 1/2 hours in so far.  The graphics are a cool, cartoonish dystopian vibe, which suits the game perfectly.  And the weapons are SUPER cool, and you can change the colours up using spray paints. Oh, and you also have a scanner where you can scan certain walls and find hidden guns.  It’s a campaign driven fps …. Gets a 100/10 from me.  I know what I’m doing all weekend. ❤️❤️❤️❤️👍👍👍 Devs,  you should add a sound effect  when you collect ammo.
Finally a single player game with lengthy single player campaign, great graphics and mechanics. There is also very fair price for the title. Can only recommend it! What a nice surprise!

So many roguelites are disappointing—they either end right when you're finally getting into the groove, or they get lazy with repetitive level design. But the newly released DISCOVERY delivers a map big enough to offer a genuine sense of exploration that I haven't felt in a standalone VR game in a very long time.

The fascinating world, detailed weapon customization, wide variety of gear, and fun vehicle movement make the gameplay incredibly engaging.

If future updates bring co-op/multiplayer modes and support for more languages, this will easily be a perfect title. Really looking forward to what's coming next!
I watched Wolf In VR play this and it looked better than Star Wars Tales From The Galaxy. So it was an instant buy for me
a good well rounded single player experience, definitely worth the price tag
